summary.text: Jon Koznick is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 57A, where Ballotpedia lists the current tenure as beginning in 2015, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Democrat JD Delgado is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Jon Koznick holds a bachelor's degree from St. Cloud State University and lists his profession as loan consultant.
Jon Koznick won re-election in 2020, 2022 and 2024, most recently defeating Veda Kanitz on November 5, 2024.

Koznick's 2025-2026 committee assignments included the House Capital Investment Committee, the House Transportation Finance and Policy Committee (as Co-Chair), the Ways and Means Committee and the State Government Finance and Policy Committee.
